notes: Curated core of the Elixir standard library as written in Elixir itself: Kernel (the core macros and functions imported by default), Enum, String, Macro, Code, Module, Exception, File, Access, List, Keyword. Left out for the ~1M budget: the rest of lib/elixir/lib (e.g. GenServer/Supervisor/Task in elixir_otp_core.txt, Stream, System, Registry, Calendar, Regex, Base, URI, Date/Time, Protocol, Inspect), lib/elixir/src (Erlang compiler internals) and lib/elixir/unicode (data tables). Files joined with '--- SOURCE: <repo path> ---' separators, code unmodified.
